Game Overview

Bullet Strike puts players into a gun experience centered on join a daring Gunman at the Princess's event, tasked with eliminating spooky skeletons. Strategically aim and shoot with limited bullets to score coins and avoid an empty gun. Precision and strategy ensure survival, creating a thrilling blend of skillful marksmanship and quick thinking.
